# BadmintonJustin

> > Online badminton coaching and community resources from 7x US Champion Justin Ma, featuring personalized training programs, equipment guides, and a comprehensive directory of 699+ badminton clubs across the USA.

BadmintonJustin is a comprehensive badminton coaching and community platform led by Justin Ma, a 7x US Junior National Champion. The site combines expert coaching services with practical resources including a racket finder tool, club directory, and educational blog content for players of all levels.

## Key Topics

- Justin Ma
- 7x US Junior National Champion
- Badminton Mastery Program
- Online Coaching
- Badminton Club Directory
- Badminton Racket Finder
- Club Reviews
- Badminton Training
- USA Badminton Community
- Adult Improvement
- Badminton Facilities
- BWF
- Yonex
- Badminton World Championships
- Coaching Technique

## Core Services & Tools

- [Justin Ma Badminton Online Coaching | 7x US Badminton Champion](https://www.badmintonjustin.com): Homepage for Justin Ma's online badminton coaching and Badminton Mastery program
- [Free Badminton Racket Finder Tool](https://www.badmintonjustin.com/badminton-racket-finder): Interactive tool to find personalized badminton racket recommendations
- [Justin Ma - Online Badminton Coaching Blog](https://www.badmintonjustin.com/blog): Blog hub covering badminton coaching, technique, equipment, and training

## About & Credentials

- [The Truth About Justin Ma | 7x US Junior National Champion](https://www.badmintonjustin.com/my-story): About page detailing Justin Ma's professional journey and credentials

## Badminton Club Directory

- [All The Badminton Clubs Across the USA [2025 Updated]](https://www.badmintonjustin.com/clubs): Comprehensive directory of 699+ badminton clubs across the USA
